question: The Parliament of which country passed the Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025** was introduced and deliberated in the **Parliament of India** to bring significant reforms to the management of Waqf properties across the country.
 
• The bill seeks to amend the existing **Waqf Act, 1995**, which has governed the administration of Waqf assets for nearly **three decades**.
 
• One of the primary objectives of the **2025** amendment is to rename the act to the **Unified Waqf Management, Empowerment, Efficiency and Development Act**.
 
• The legislation proposes mandatory representation of **women** and **non-Muslims** in both the **Central Waqf Council** and the **State Waqf Boards** to ensure diversity and inclusive governance.
